name: FixelHub Site Clone Pro
author: fixelhub

sections.description:
Help, step-by-step guide and FAQ: fixelhub.com/site-clone-pro

FixelHub Site Clone Pro copies your whole site – database, media, themes, plugins and other wp-content files – into one package. Import the package on another WordPress site and it becomes an exact copy. If the address changes, every link, image and path is updated automatically, including serialized data and page-builder (Elementor, JSON) data.

Features

  • Full site export into one .fhsc package (up to 2 GB)
  • Import on a fresh WordPress install on any server
  • New domain, subdomain, subfolder, http > https, and table-prefix changes handled automatically
  • Optional test copy mode (no emails, no cron, hidden from search engines)
  • System check before export and import: green = OK, yellow = warning, red = must fix (installation stays locked)
  • Works in small steps, so short PHP time limits and small upload limits are no problem
  • Continues where it stopped if the page is closed or the connection drops

Safety

  • Export only reads the site – nothing is changed.
  • The package is verified before import; damaged or incomplete packages are rejected.
  • The database is imported into a temporary copy. The site keeps using its own database until the very last step.
  • Every file that is replaced is backed up first.
  • The switch to the new database is one single all-or-nothing step. The old database is renamed, not deleted.
  • If anything fails, “Undo everything” puts every file back and deletes the temporary copy.
  • wp-config.php, .htaccess and WordPress core files are never changed.
  • Optional safe mode: when you turn it on, other plugins and the theme are not loaded during the plugin’s own requests, so they can’t interrupt a clone. It adds one small file to wp-content/mu-plugins only after you click “Turn on safe mode”, and removes it when you turn it off or deactivate the plugin.
  • After an import you log in with a username and password from the old site. The plugin never logs anyone in by itself.

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external service. Export, import and all checks run on your own server. Packages are only sent where you take them (download and upload in your browser).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the zip in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Tools > Site Clone Pro.

Full guide with screenshots: fixelhub.com/site-clone-pro
sections.faq:
Where can I get help?

See the guide and FAQ on fixelhub.com/site-clone-pro, or ask in the plugin’s support forum here on WordPress.org.

Where are packages stored?

In wp-content/uploads/fixelhub-site-clone-pro/, inside a folder with a random name. It is protected from web access and the random name can’t be guessed. The Import tab shows the exact folder.

What happens to my old site after an import?

Its database tables are kept with the prefix fhsco… and every replaced file is kept in the storage folder, until you click “Clean up backup”.

Does it support Multisite?

Not yet – single sites only.

What is not copied?

WordPress core files and wp-config.php (the new site uses its own), caches, other backup plugins’ folders, and server-specific drop-ins (object-cache.php, advanced-cache.php, db.php) that can break a site on a different server.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1

  • Safe mode is now optional and only turned on when you click “Turn on safe mode” in the system check.
  • Folders are found with WordPress functions (get_theme_root(), plugin_dir_path(), wp_upload_dir(), WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR, get_home_path()) instead of WP_CONTENT_DIR / ABSPATH.
  • Custom layouts work, e.g. uploads outside wp-content: files go to the right folder and links are updated.
  • Storage folder is now wp-content/uploads/fixelhub-site-clone-pro/ (existing packages are moved automatically).
  • New package format – create packages again after updating.

2.0.0

  • All database queries now use $wpdb->prepare().
  • New package format (packages made with version 1 need to be created again).
  • No automatic login after an import – log in with the old site’s account.
  • Stricter checks of all request data.
  • Requires WordPress 6.2 or newer.

1.0.0

  • First release.

short_description: Clone, back up and move your complete WordPress site to a new server, domain, subdomain or folder, with a system check before every step.
